newsitem.title: USA: UnionBanCal to redeem $135 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: UnionBanCal to redeem $135 mln preferred.

text.p: UnionBanCal Corp said Friday it will redeem the outstanding $135 million of depositary shares representing its 8-3/8 percent noncumulative series A preferred stock on September 3.
The company said the preferred stock was issued in 1992 in the form of depositary shares, each of which represents a one-fourth interest in a share of Series A preferred stock.

The redemption price will be $25 per depositary share plus 36.640625 cents in dividends accrued to the redemption date, to shareholders of record on August 1, the company said. This amount will be paid upon presentation of the depositary shares on or after September 3.
Dividends on the depositary shares will cease to accrue from the redemption date, it said. Shareholders should take no action until they receive redemption notices, which will be mailed soon.

UnionBanCal Corporation also announced the issuance of $200 million in subordinated capital notes through Tokyo-Mitsubishi International PLC, a unit of The Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd. The funds will be used for redemption of the preferred stock and general corporate purposes.
